capabilities: Maintain a global custom word list inside the .obsidian folder
Apply the global list to the native spellcheck dictionary
Merge local device words into the global list
Replace the local dictionary with the global list, with a merge popup when over 5 words would be deleted
Poll every 15 seconds for local and external dictionary changes
disambiguation: Not a word-lookup or thesaurus dictionary; it only syncs the custom spellcheck word list.
extras: Relies on Electron's internal Session dictionary API, so it may break if Obsidian changes or restricts that API; README recommends backing up large dictionaries; no mobile support; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin aims to make syncing Obsidian's native spellcheck dictionary on desktop possible.
problem: Obsidian's native spellcheck custom dictionary lives per device, so words added on one desktop do not appear on another.

relations.evidence: using any sync strategy such as Obsidian Sync should automatically handle the syncing of the custom word list

requires.name: Obsidian Sync or another sync strategy

summary: Spellcheck dictionary syncer that keeps a global custom word list in .obsidian and applies it to Obsidian's native spellcheck across desktop devices.
